applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: GL audit stuck as pending, will not book, or review task incomplete
symptoms: GL audits stuck as pending and cannot be closed
Booking error on a GL audit
Exposure and rating review task incomplete
cause: The audit waits on an open review activity, or the billing message failed or was not acknowledged, so the audit cannot complete.
diagnosis: Check open activities on the policy
Check Administration > Message Queues for billing destination errors
resolution: Complete or reassign the open review activity
Retry failed billing messages and resync with Billing
Complete the audit, or withdraw and restart it
If needed, paired data fixes in PolicyCenter and Billing
permanent_fix: Monitor for audits pending more than 5 days; alert on billing message failures.
escalation: PC L2 Application Support, then Integration Support / Billing Support.
